title: Dashboard: equalise card heights (fix centering + font timing)
body:
## Summary
Supersedes #23 which merged before two fixes were applied:

- Restores `margin: '0 auto'` on the grid (lost during branch stash pop)
- Re-measures card heights after `document.fonts.ready` so DotGothic16 loading doesn't clip text on hard refresh

## Test plan
- [ ] All 17 tests pass
- [ ] Cards are equal height on desktop
- [ ] Grid is centered on wide displays
- [ ] Hard refresh shows no clipped text
